Upon waking up, I find myself in a world I've never seen before.
Right in front of me is a Bananya, a little kitty peeking out from a banana.
I can hardly believe my eyes. Somehow, my body has become a banana too...

Together with the Bananyas, I set off on a journey, traveling through forests, over mountains, and to all kinds of places.

A journey to find the sparkling treasure that a little one has lost

Sell extra inventory to make a quick buck, then go on a shopping spree at Meowtor Deliveries, where you can buy exotic goods from the distant lands of Earth.
